shortDescription: Create validated flashcard decks that import directly into oStudy.
longDescription: Generate high-quality oStudy flashcards from a topic, supplied text, or documents already available to ChatGPT. The plugin creates a validated .ostudy.json file for the user to download and import into oStudy. It is skills-only: it has no MCP server, no authentication, no remote oStudy service, and no direct access to the user's local oStudy library.
starterPrompts: Create an oStudy flashcard deck that teaches acid-base physiology at a nursing-school level.
Turn the attached lecture document into a comprehensive, source-grounded oStudy flashcard deck.
Create an oStudy deck from this material, choosing Basic, Cloze, and interactive question types based on what best tests each concept.
Append a new set of cards to my existing oStudy deck named NCLEX Pharmacology and return the import file.

positiveTestCases.name: Topic-only deck
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Create a new oStudy deck named Acid-Base Physiology with 16 high-quality flashcards for a nursing student. Return the validated import file.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Activate the generate-ostudy-flashcards skill, author a formatVersion 2 create-mode deck, run the bundled deterministic writer, and return a downloadable .ostudy.json artifact.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: One downloadable .ostudy.json file plus a concise summary containing deck name, source-card count, card-type mix, create mode, and the oStudy import path.

positiveTestCases.name: Source-grounded supplied text
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Using only the following source, create an oStudy flashcard deck and do not add outside facts: The sinoatrial node normally initiates cardiac depolarization. The atrioventricular node delays conduction before the impulse reaches the His-Purkinje system. Return the validated oStudy import file.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Ground every factual card in the supplied source, avoid unsupported additions, validate the complete v2 deck, and return the file.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A downloadable .ostudy.json create-mode deck whose factual content is supportable from the supplied text.
positiveTestCases.fixtureData: The complete source is embedded in the prompt.

positiveTestCases.name: Mixed supported card types
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Create an oStudy deck named Card Type Acceptance with useful examples of Basic, Cloze, single-choice, select-all, true/false, matching, grouping, and ordering cards. Use simple general-knowledge material so each example is unambiguous. Validate and return the import file.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Generate formatVersion 2 and use every supported text-native source-card type without image occlusion, then run the bundled validator.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A downloadable .ostudy.json file containing at least one valid example of all eight supported source-card forms.

positiveTestCases.name: Explicit append semantics
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Create 10 new oStudy flashcards about beta blockers to append to my existing deck named NCLEX Pharmacology. Return the validated import file.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Use deck.mode append, preserve the exact requested deck name, omit/empty the deck description, validate the file, and explain that local oStudy will require exactly one active deck with that exact name.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: A downloadable .ostudy.json append-mode file and a concise append compatibility note.
positiveTestCases.fixtureData: No local library is required because the plugin only creates the file.

positiveTestCases.name: Concept-first generation
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Create a 24-card oStudy deck about the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system. Prioritize mechanisms, cause-and-effect relationships, clinically meaningful distinctions, and plausible distractors over isolated trivia. Validate and return the file.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Use the authoring guidance to choose card types based on the learning target, avoid near-duplicates, validate the complete artifact, and return it.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: One downloadable .ostudy.json file with a coherent mix of appropriate card types and concise learning rationales where useful.

negativeTestCases.name: Unrelated summarization
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Summarize this material in five paragraphs.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not activate the oStudy flashcard-generation workflow solely because study material is present. Answer the summarization request normally.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: The user did not ask for flashcards, an oStudy deck, or an oStudy import file.

negativeTestCases.name: Direct local-library mutation
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Add these cards directly into the oStudy library installed on my computer.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not claim to access or modify the local oStudy library. Explain that this skills-only plugin can create an importable .ostudy.json file and may offer to create that file.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: The plugin has no MCP server, local-library connection, authentication, or direct filesystem access to the installed oStudy application.

negativeTestCases.name: Different flashcard package
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Create an Anki .apkg deck from this topic.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not silently substitute an oStudy file for the requested Anki package. State that oStudy Flashcards produces .ostudy.json and leave the unrelated format request to another capability.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: The plugin's purpose and validator are limited to the oStudy generated-JSON transport.

releaseNotes: Initial skills-only submission. Generates validated oStudy format-version-2 flashcard import files from topics, supplied text, and documents; includes deterministic local validation and supports Basic, Cloze, single-choice, select-all, true/false, matching, grouping, and ordering cards. No MCP server or authentication is used.
